serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Lady Annalie: I should probably already order things like new windows, furniture, etc. but to be honest I don’t really have the money for it…
You: If you want, I can lend you some. How about 10k? 
#Annalie.face.shocked
Lady Annalie: Really?! That’s a lot of money, you know?
#Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.normal
You: Don’t worry about it, I can afford this much.
Lady Annalie: I will give it back as soon as I can. This really means a lot to me.
You: I’m glad I could be of help.
Lady Annalie: Alright then! I will go order things and you can try to clean up a little bit. I will join you as soon as I can.
You: Sure!
